svg.aria-label: The analysis chain: a file under data/ becomes a hashed DATASET, a declared ANALYSIS script reads it and writes results.json, each finding becomes a RESULT, and a RESULT becomes a table and a figure; repro check compares every recorded hash with the workspace as it is now.
svg.title: The analysis chain: a file under data/ becomes a hashed DATASET, a declared ANALYSIS script reads it and writes results.json, each finding becomes a RESULT, and a RESULT becomes a table and a figure; repro check compares every recorded hash with the workspace as it is now.
svg.text: Every run records what it read and what it wrote. Edit the csv and everything downstream says so.
